name: grid-train
_comment: Cube-terrain (CubeGridDuckEnv) training leg. The CUDA engine has no cubes, so this leg trains on the SANDBOX CPUS via walk.train.run + the dwv1 CPU world layer; the GPU sits idle (gpu:1 only because the launcher provisions GPU sandboxes). Relay contract mirrors continue-ff-short: upload runs/grid-warmstart.pt (a walk.train.run checkpoint, e.g. from walk.train.grid_curriculum.make_warmstart_checkpoint or a stage latest.pt), the leg advances it ~45 PPO updates on the stage grid, judges it with walk.eval.grid_acceptance, and ships latest.pt back. Change the STAGE variable in the train job to move up the ladder (flush | rough4 | rough8; specs in walk/eval/grid_acceptance.py).

jobs.name: build
jobs.command: set -o pipefail; command -v clang++ >/dev/null 2>&1 || (apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq clang) 2>&1 | tail -1; PY=$(command -v python3); $PY -c 'import numpy' 2>/dev/null || $PY -m pip install --quiet numpy; $PY -B -c 'from walk.env import world; print("libduck_world:", world.build())' 2>&1 | tee build.log

jobs.name: train
jobs.command: set -o pipefail; STAGE=flush; PY=$(command -v python3); U=$($PY -B -c 'import torch; print(int(torch.load("runs/grid-warmstart.pt", map_location="cpu", weights_only=False)["update"]))'); GRID=$($PY -B -c "import json; from walk.eval.grid_acceptance import stage_grid; print(json.dumps({'environments': 2, 'grid': stage_grid('$STAGE')}))"); mkdir -p grid-train-out && cp runs/grid-warmstart.pt grid-train-out/latest.pt; $PY -B -m walk.train.run --env walk.env.grid:CubeGridDuckEnv --env-kwargs "$GRID" --workers 8 --horizon 64 --updates $((U+45)) --seed 917 --out grid-train-out --resume --checkpoint-every 5 --eval-every 0 --preflight-steps 0 --torch-threads 2 --lr 7.5e-5 --target-kl 0.05 2>&1 | tee grid-train.log

jobs.name: judge
jobs.command: set -o pipefail; STAGE=flush; PY=$(command -v python3); $PY -B -m walk.eval.grid_acceptance --actor grid-train-out/latest.pt --stage $STAGE --out grid-judge --jobs 4 2>&1 | tee grid-judge.log
